term_and_condition:
Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

1. Program Overview

This Affiliate Program is designed to reward affiliates for promoting our products and driving sales through unique affiliate links. By participating, affiliates agree to the terms outlined below.

2. Eligibility

Affiliates must:

  1. Be at least 18 years of age.
  2. Provide accurate and complete account information.
  3. Actively promote products in a manner consistent with our brand values.

3. Affiliate Links

Each affiliate is assigned a unique link to track referrals and sales. This link must only be shared with potential customers through approved channels such as personal websites, social media platforms, and email campaigns.

4. Prohibited Activities

The following practices are strictly prohibited and may result in removal from the program or forfeiture of commissions:

  1. Self-Referral:
    Affiliates are not allowed to use their own affiliate links to make personal purchases or orders intended for their use.

  2. Fraudulent Transactions:
    Any attempt to manipulate the program through fake orders, duplicate accounts, or other unethical means is prohibited.

  3. Misrepresentation of the Brand:
    Affiliates must not make false claims about our products or mislead customers.

5. Commission Policy

  1. Commissions are earned on qualifying purchases made through valid affiliate links by new and unique customers.
  2. A minimum of [X unique customer referrals] must be achieved before commissions are eligible for payout.

6. Payment Terms

  1. Commissions are calculated and paid out on a monthly basis after review.
  2. Payments are issued via paypal, venmo, bank transfer
  3. Self-referrals and orders flagged as abuse will not be eligible for commission.

7. Monitoring and Review

We reserve the right to review affiliate activity, including purchase and referral data, to ensure compliance with the program. Suspicious activities will result in:

  1. A warning for first-time offenses.
  2. Permanent removal from the program for repeated violations.

8. Termination

We reserve the right to terminate an affiliate's participation at any time, especially in cases of policy violations or inactivity.

9. Modifications

These terms and conditions are subject to change. Affiliates will be notified of updates via email or an announcement on the affiliate portal.

10. Contact

For questions or concerns, affiliates can contact us at Rareuvink@gmail.com
